goal: Reduce runtime/plan_core.ts to the validator surface production actually reaches and remove the two orphans in runtime/v4_runtime.ts, using the compiler rather than a name list to decide which bodies are genuinely unreachable.

acceptance.assertion: runtime/plan_core.ts exports only the surface reached from production: PlanValidationError and projectPlanValidation, the two symbols runtime/v4_runtime.ts imports. The other 30 exports are de-exported first and only then deleted, and `bun run typecheck` is what determines which bodies are genuinely unreachable, because projectPlanValidation may retain internal call paths through symbols that look unused from outside. No symbol is deleted from a name list alone.

The two orphans in runtime/v4_runtime.ts are removed: the READ_ONLY_V3_COMMANDS constant, which is declared and referenced nowhere in the repository, and the unused `command` and `args` parameters of retiredResponse. The read-only v3 CLI wall itself is unchanged and still refuses the retired commands with the same message.

Plan validation behavior is unchanged for every input the live validator still serves: tests/plan-validation.test.ts passes with no assertion weakened, and any test in it whose only protected subject was a now-deleted export is removed with an explicit statement of which behavior retired.
